test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The table shows the production of different types of cars (in thousands).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c30659f72b84a4d7423d6e8dcf7d26f978f575f8285f23f177f1591e782a5e6c.png] 

What is the ratio of the total production of cars of type Q in 2020 and type R in 2022 taken together to the total production of cars of type S in 2019 and type P in 2021 taken together?
solution:
**Given:**

Total production of cars:

Type Q in 2020 = 25 thousand

Type R in 2022 = 39 thousand

Type S in 2019 = 69 thousand

Type P in 2021 = 71 thousands

**Calculation:**

Total production of Type Q (2020) + Type R (2022) = 25 + 39 = 64 thousand.

Total production of Type S (2019) + Type P (2021) = 69 + 71 = 140 thousands.

⇒ Ratio = 64 : 140

⇒ Ratio = 16 : 35

**The correct answer is Option (4).**
